title: Eleven Winters and One Short Label
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（人与社会·科学与技术）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（人与社会·科学与技术）　|　核心词汇：evidence　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 evidence 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 my father ① gathered evidence that no researcher in the lab would have published, and he said the gathering was the whole of the winter. The ② evidence, meaning the data itself and not the claim, ran eleven winters and stayed unpublished in the book; evidence, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unpublished.

Every ③ piece of evidence in that lab had the same short label beside it, and the ④ evidence at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the paper and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Evidence, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to publish; my father said the publishing is the part that fills eleven winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the evidence was the whole of the case, meaning the proof and not the data. The ⑥ evidence, meaning the proof and not any of that, is the only thing in a case that everybody waits for and nobody publishes; evidence, he said, is either something you gather or the only word that means both data and proof. He said the proof is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ evidence had become a line in a table, and the table had become an argument about the short label. The ⑧ evidence of the whole thing, my father wrote in January, was one lab and eleven winters of publishing; evidence, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to publish. He said the publishing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ evidence I remember is the one published in the table, which closed in 1986 and is still described as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ piece of evidence, my mother said in 1988, is the only one that improves by being published; every evidence, she said, is a proof that has agreed to look like a set of data. She said the proof was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 证据；依据（指实验室里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 证据（指那些数据本身，与论断相对）
C. 固定搭配：gather evidence 收集证据
D. n. 证据（指留给论文的那一份）
E. n. 证据（抽象总称，指一间实验室的取证之事）
F. n. 证据（指表格上写到、被发表的那一份）
G. n. 证明；佐证（指一个案例里人人都等却无人发表的那样东西）
H. n. 证明（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人发表的那样东西）

items.q: gathered evidence that no researcher in the lab would have published
The evidence, meaning the data itself and not the claim

answers.why: gather evidence 意为“收集证据”，1974 年父亲收集了一份实验室里没有一位研究员肯发表的证据。
evidence 意为“证据”，指那些数据本身而不是论断，它经过了十一个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
evidence 意为“证据”，指实验室里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一张短短的标签。
evidence 意为“证据”，指留给论文的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
evidence 意为“证明、佐证”，指一个案例里人人都等却无人发表的那样东西，叔叔说这个证明就是那个案例的全部。
evidence 意为“证明”，指人人都等却无人发表的那样东西而不是那些数据，是案例里人人都等、却无人发表的东西。
evidence 意为“证据”，指表格上写到、被发表的那一份，到 1982 年这一份成了表格里的一行。
evidence 意为“证据”，父亲一月写道，整件事的取证之事是一间实验室和十一个冬天的发表。
evidence 意为“证据”，我记得的是表格上发表的那一份，1986 年结束了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一份。
evidence 为抽象总称，母亲 1988 年说，一份证据是唯一会因为被好好发表而变得更好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年父亲收集了一份实验室里没有一位研究员肯发表的证据，他说收集才是那个冬天的全部。（gather evidence）
那份证据，指的是那些数据本身而不是论断，经过了十一个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。（evidence）
那间实验室里每一份证据旁边都有同一张短短的标签。（evidence）
远处那一端证据，指的是他们留给论文的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（evidence）
叔叔说这个证明就是那个案例的全部，指的是那份佐证而不是那些数据。（evidence）
1988 年母亲说，一份证据是唯一会因为被好好发表而变得更好的东西。（evidence）
answers: In 1974 my father gathered evidence that no researcher in the lab would have published, and he said the gathering was the whole of the winter.

The evidence at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the paper and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
